meaning:
ἀν-έρχομαι
[in LXX: 3Ki.13:12 (הָלַךְ)* ;]
to go up: Jhn.6:3, Gal.1:17-18 (cf. ἐπανέρχ-; and on its use of "going up " to the capital, MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.
nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.
